description: This file handles AJAX requests to configure WPS settings for Wi-Fi access points, including enabling/disabling WPS, setting methods, and pairing clients via push button or PIN. It processes JSON input and interacts with device configuration via setStr calls.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates a WPS PIN checksum, supporting 4- and 8-digit PINs, with checksum verification for 8-digit PINs.

methods.name: MiniApplySSID
methods.description: Applies Wi-Fi SSID settings for a specified SSID number, toggling settings for radio interfaces.
